name: University of Pikeville
tuition_note: 2026-27 tuition & fees (private single rate: $26,500 tuition + $150 fees on-campus = ~$26,650) from upike.edu/undergraduate/financial-aid/cost-of-attendance/; room only = standard room $4,950/year (single occupancy $6,950) from same page. Board (food) is separately ~$4,700/year.
